newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Firestone, Bridgestone ponder cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Firestone, Bridgestone ponder cooperation.

text.p: Firestone New Zealand Ltd (FSNZ) on Thursday said Bridgestone Corporation recently acquired 100 percent of the stock of Bridgestone Tyres (NZ) Ltd (BSNZ).
The majority shareholder of FSNZ is Bridgestone/Firestone Inc, which is a wholly-owned unit of Bridgestone Corp.
"FSNZ and BSNZ will engage in discussions to consider areas of possible cooperation," Firestone said in a statement.

"Any agreement of FSNZ and BSNZ management resulting from these discussions would be subject to the approval of shareholders of FSNZ and BSNZ, to the extent required by law and or New Zealand Stock Exchange requirements," it said.
